firstSteps.title: Getting started with Kaizen
firstSteps.step1: Create your account and fill in your profile (weight, height, goal).
firstSteps.step2: Connect a data source (Apple Health, Garmin, or Renpho).
firstSteps.step3: Set a main goal in Goals — it personalizes the whole app.

appleHealth.title: Set up Apple Health (Health Auto Export)
appleHealth.step1: Install Health Auto Export on your iPhone.
appleHealth.step2: Profile → Devices → Apple Health → generate your token.
appleHealth.step3: In HAE: Automations → REST API, paste the URL (token included), POST method, JSON format.
appleHealth.step4: Check sleep, resting HR, weight… then run it once to verify.

garmin.title: Connect Garmin
garmin.step2: Authorize access in the Garmin Connect window.
garmin.step3: Your activities and health data (sleep, HRV, HR) sync automatically.

renpho.title: Set up Renpho
renpho.step1: Enable Apple Health sync in the Renpho app.
renpho.step2: Weigh yourself: weight, body fat and muscle mass go to Apple Health.
renpho.step3: Kaizen picks them up via Health Auto Export, source “Renpho”.

deficit.title: Track your calorie deficit
deficit.step3: Adjust your kcal/macro targets in Nutrition if needed.

recovery.title: Understand the Recovery Score
recovery.step1: The score combines sleep, HRV and resting HR vs your averages.
recovery.step2: The higher it is, the more ready you are for an intense session.
recovery.step3: Without HRV (Garmin doesn't push it to Health), it relies mostly on sleep.

sleep.q: Why isn't my sleep showing up?
sleep.a: Check that your source is actually sending nights: Apple Health via Health Auto Export (check “Sleep Analysis”) or a Garmin export. On the Sleep screen, quality shows up as soon as a night is received, whatever the source.

hrv.a: Garmin doesn't send HRV to Apple Health — no third-party app can re-share it. For HRV, use a Garmin export import instead.

garmin.a: Profile → Devices → Garmin → Connect, then authorize access in Garmin Connect. Requires the backend to be deployed.

kaizenScore.q: How does the Kaizen Score work?
kaizenScore.a: It's a composite read of your form: recovery, sleep, training load and consistency. Each component is explainable and shown separately — never an opaque number.

deficit.q: How do I calculate my calorie deficit?
deficit.a: Deficit = calorie target − calories consumed. Kaizen estimates your target from your weight, but you can adjust it manually in Nutrition (kcal, protein, water).

export.q: How do I export my data?
export.a: Settings → Privacy → Export my data (JSON, GDPR format). You can also do it from Data & integrations.
